name: Account controlled or used by someone other than the holder
description: Signs that a third party holds the card, PIN, credentials or device, or that funds and activity belong to someone other than the named holder.
fp: Family members, agents and authorised signatories may legitimately operate accounts.

links.name: Gig worker account operated by someone else
links.ctx: Mismatched face, device or location against the verified worker.

links.name: Wages paid to accounts controlled by employer or agent
links.ctx: Workers' pay lands in accounts accessed by employer, with cards held by employer or agent.
links.fp: Some employers manage accounts for migrant workers with consent.

links.name: Account controlled by a third party
links.ctx: Someone other than the account holder appears to hold the card, PIN or online credentials, accompanying the holder or accessing from a shared device.
links.fp: Family members, carers and partners may legitimately help with banking.

links.name: Account controlled by someone other than holder
links.ctx: Signs of third-party control such as shared devices, mandates.

links.name: Account sharing or intermediary accounts used by third parties
links.ctx: Customer account is used for third-party funds.
